decision.reasoning_trace: I was primarily looking for a high-capacity backpack suitable for multi-day trips. I narrowed my search to the High Sierra Pathway (prod_backpacks_068) and the Osprey Exos (prod_backpacks_003) as the primary technical options. While the Osprey is a premium brand, the High Sierra offered a significantly better price-to-volume ratio for its 70L capacity and maintained a high rating (4.7) with positive sentiment regarding its internal frame. I included specialized options like the Rawlings equipment bag (prod_backpacks_072) and smaller tactical/sling bags (prod_backpacks_050, prod_backpacks_182) for comparison, but they lacked the necessary volume and features for heavy hiking use.
